KIDLEARN PRIVACY NOTICE

1. WHO WE ARE
KidLearn Technologies Private Limited is the Data Fiduciary for this service. Our registered
office is at 22 MG Road, Bengaluru 560001. You can reach our Data Protection Officer at
dpo@kidlearn.in or on +91 80 4000 1000.

2. NOTICE AND WHAT WE COLLECT
This Notice is presented to you before, or at the time of, the collection of your personal data,
and accompanies every request for your consent. We collect the child's first name, age, grade
level, and the parent's email address and mobile number. Each item is collected for the specific
purpose of creating a learning profile and reporting progress to the parent.

3. CHILDREN'S DATA
Our service is directed at children under the age of eighteen. Before processing any personal
data of a child, we obtain verifiable consent from the parent or lawful guardian. We verify that
the individual identifying themselves as the parent is an adult by checking reliable details of
identity and age, or through a virtual token mapped to those details issued by an authorised
entity.

We do not undertake any tracking or behavioural monitoring of children, and we do not serve
targeted advertising directed at children.

4. CONSENT
Your consent is free, specific, informed, unconditional and unambiguous, and is given through a
clear affirmative action. We present each purpose separately with its own unticked checkbox.
Nothing is pre-selected. You may withdraw your consent at any time from Settings > Privacy >
Manage Consent. Withdrawing consent is as easy as giving it.

5. YOUR RIGHTS
You may request a summary of the personal data we hold, request correction of inaccurate or
incomplete data, and request erasure. To exercise your rights of access, correction, updating,
erasure or nomination, write to dpo@kidlearn.in or visit Settings > Privacy > My Data. You may
nominate another individual to exercise your rights in the event of death or incapacity.

6. GRIEVANCE REDRESSAL
Our Grievance Officer is Ms R. Iyer, reachable at grievance@kidlearn.in. We acknowledge every
grievance within 3 working days and resolve it within 30 days. If you remain dissatisfied you may
make a complaint to the Data Protection Board of India.

7. SECURITY
We encrypt personal data in transit using TLS 1.3 and at rest using AES-256. We enforce
role-based access control on the principle of least privilege and maintain access logs which we
review. We run annual staff privacy training and an annual independent security audit.

8. BREACH
In the event of a personal data breach we will intimate each affected Data Principal without
delay, and provide the Data Protection Board with detailed information within seventy-two hours
of becoming aware of the breach.

9. RETENTION
We retain a learning profile for 24 months after the last activity. When you withdraw consent, or
once the purpose is no longer served, we erase that personal data and instruct every Data
Processor acting on our behalf to erase their copies, unless retention is required by law.
